answer: Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 40 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. The meadow schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the tide checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. An adversary wanting 26 effective identities must lock that capital for 40 epochs and keep it locked through every delta audit. That is 17 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
